market.summary: India caught up with Monday's US rally after the holiday: Nifty +1.85% to 25,819 and Sensex +1.82%, led by private banks and financials, with FIIs buying again and Brent easing to about $88. The rally was narrow: small caps fell 0.44% and metals and media dropped, so your mid and small holdings did not all join in. US PCE inflation and Q3 GDP came out at 7 pm IST and US markets are shut Thursday for Thanksgiving.

points.text: Wed 25 Nov close: Sensex 83,938 (+1.82%), Nifty 50 25,819 (+1.85%); Midcap 100 +0.30%, Smallcap 100 -0.44%. Private banks +2.2%, financial services +2.2%, IT +1.1%; metals -2.0%, media -4.4%.
NSE provisional flows, 25 Nov: FIIs bought a net Rs 4,479 Cr and DIIs Rs 4,019 Cr; FIIs have now been net buyers 11 sessions in a row.
Brent February futures about $88.5 a barrel in Asian trade, a little lower; reports of vessel attacks near the Strait of Hormuz keep a floor under oil. MCX gold -1.2%, silver -1.8%.
US, Tue 24 Nov: S&P 500 -0.50%, Nasdaq -1.48% as chip and AI stocks gave back part of Monday's rally; Dow +0.85% above 50,000.

market.watch: Whether small caps follow the large-cap rally; THELEELA closed just 0.07% above its 10 EMA and is the trade closest to a rule exit.

GROWW.summary: No new filing or company news today. The stock rose 0.5% to Rs 217.48 on a day financials led the market, but it stayed under its 10 EMA (Rs 219.58); you already sold 43% on 23 Nov, so the rest exits only on a close below the 20 EMA (Rs 214.66), now 1.3% away. Repeated block sales by early investors (Ribbit on 17 Nov, an unnamed Rs 3,708 Cr block on 6 Nov) keep supply overhead.

points.text: Close Rs 217.48 (+1.38R on Rs 200.80 entry); 10 EMA 219.58, 20 EMA 214.66 = exit level for the remaining shares.
17 Nov: Ribbit Capital entities sold about 8.7 crore shares (about Rs 1,905 Cr) at Rs 219 in block deals; buyers included BlackRock, Kotak MF, Fidelity and Morgan Stanley funds.
6 Nov: a block of 17.42 crore shares (2.8% of equity, about Rs 3,708 Cr) traded at an average Rs 215; the stock fell about 4.6% intraday that day.
Nifty Financial Services rose 2.2% today, so the sector backdrop was supportive.

GROWW.watch: A close below Rs 214.66 exits the rest; a close back above Rs 219.58 (10 EMA) shows the trend resuming.
